notes.notes:

[hr][/hr][h3]Ready your cameras and prepare to begin your investigation![/h3]

[h2]Hello Neighbor 2 is Available Now![/h2]

It's time to renew your investigation and return to the sleepy little town with a [i]bit[/i] of a missing person problem and a [b]whole[/b] a lot of mystery. Can you get to the bottom of what's really going on in Raven Brooks? Dive deeper into the town's dark secrets and uncover new sides to the story of how Mr. Peterson became "The Neighbor." 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321680/Hello_Neighbor_2/
[hr][/hr]
[h3][u]Attend the exclusive advance viewing of Welcome to Raven Brooks[/u][/h3]

Want to see Hello Neighbor Animated Series: Welcome to Raven Brooks before anyone else? Simply start up your last Hello Neighbor 2 save! Yes, you heard that right, we are [i]literally[/i] throwing the exclusive premiere of Welcome To Raven Brooks, [u][b]from inside[/b] Raven brooks! [/u]

So when you come across a strange television set with a countdown timer on it, go ahead and grab some popcorn and snacks before the big show! And if you missed the initial showing don't worry!

[u][h3][url=https://youtu.be/z0MZRMp0nxA][b]You can catch the replay on our YouTube channel Dec 11th at 10:00AM PT![/b][/url][/h3][/u]

[h3]Level up your investigative tools, meet new Neighbors, & explore new locations + puzzles with the Hello Neighbor 2 Deluxe Edtion! [/h3]

[b]The Hello Neighbor 2 Deluxe Edition includes 3 day-one DLC:[/b]

📚 [b]Late Fees[/b]- Will you uncover something sinister in the endless maze of books that is the Raven Brooks Library? Only one way to find out!

🏫 [b]Back To School[/b] - Investigate the sprawling Raven Brooks Middle School for clues. But beware the creepy janitor and his fiendish 4-legged friends!

🚁 [b]Hello-copter[/b] - Surveil your Neighbors in style! This top-of-the-line gadget lets you spy on your suspects from safety and pilfer items with its retractable grappling claw!

[previewyoutube=RvUEaHljElg;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for being right there with us playing through every new build, demo, and alpha over the past 5 years. We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed developing it, and [u]please stay tuned for updates and post-launch news. [/u]

As always, we’ll see you in Raven Brooks.

I just launched the first Pre-Alpha build. Enjoy:

notes.title: Hello Neighbor: Hide and Seek coming in December
notes.notes:
[img]https://imgur.com/IVEIFgi.gif[/img]

Howdy there Neighbors!

We are gearing up for the Halloween-ish launch window for Secret Neighbor, and the whole team is working non-stop to make sure we get a good game that meets all of your expectations.

I may have leaked the below already on our discord ([url=https://discord.gg/secretneighbor]https://discord.gg/secretneighbor[/url]) but the details over there revolve around Neighbor's abilities and leveling. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/859570/Secret_Neighbor/

If you participated in the Secret Neighbor Beta, you will know we have character and Neighbor classes. What we didn't really like about the system was lack of progression during the match. Some Neighbor players would go haywire from minute 1, and sometimes kid players would just run off and very quickly get all keys. So we decided to change this in 2 meaningful ways. 

One is around the house itself. You will now need to progress through the house by unlocking its doors. The further you are in the house, the more high tier loot you can find, and you will need to unlock all of it to find keys to the basement. You unlock in-house doors with keycards. This creates a natural sense of progression.

To counter this, we decided to make the Neighbor level up as the match goes. The Neighbor player will need to sneak off to search for specific items that level him up, gradually unlocking his abilities. So in the very beginning it makes absolutely no sense to reveal yourself and attack others. 

I will update everyone on how this shapes up as we're still trying to balance it. 

Oh, and also - Hello Neighbor: Hide & Seek is coming to Steam this December. Rejoice! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/960420/Hello_Neighbor_Hide_and_Seek/
